features.name: Zero-dependency gateway HTTP server
features.summary: Node http server bound to 127.0.0.1:PORT(8080) with per-request x-correlation-id, loopback-only CORS reflection and OPTIONS handling, dispatching all /api and /apps routes plus static frontend.

features.name: GET /api/health
features.summary: Aggregates memory-vault integrity, mission-store integrity, worker heartbeat and connector breaker state; returns 200 ready or 503 degraded.

features.name: GET /api/services
features.summary: Probes each of the four upstreams through the connector registry and returns health plus status per service.

features.name: GET /api/connectors
features.summary: Lists connector configuration (env var, endpoint, operations, schema) and live status (breaker, latency, last error).

features.name: GET /api/unified/overview
features.summary: Fans out to four connectors for a chosen city preset, normalises waste/fire/water/air, falls back to labelled mocks, and builds the cross-project severity feed.

features.name: GET/HEAD /api/{junksnap,clearsky,teesri,vayu}/*
features.summary: Read-only passthrough proxy to the four upstream APIs (non-GET returns 405); TapAlert /api/state is reduced to anonymised aggregate counts.

features.name: GET /api/v1/cascade
features.summary: Assesses one open DumpWatch site against the nearest AirPulse monitor with radiusKm/timeWindowHours thresholds, returns an assessment plus SHA-256 evidence manifest; demo=1 serves a simulated walkthrough.

features.name: GET /api/v1/place
features.summary: Returns Open-Meteo weather, CAMS air quality and derived CO2/methane model concentrations for validated coordinates with provenance, 5-minute cache and request coalescing.

features.name: GET /api/v1/places/search
features.summary: Geocodes a 2-100 character query through Open-Meteo/GeoNames and returns up to 8 validated places.

features.name: GET /api/v1/place/facilities
features.summary: Queries OpenStreetMap Overpass for mapped power plants and industrial works within 0-25 km (max 40 features) with explicit not-production/not-emissions provenance notes.

features.name: GET /api/v1/projects
features.summary: Serves the validated registry/projects.json plus per-app on-disk availability for standalone apps.

features.name: GET/HEAD /apps/<id>/*
features.summary: Serves registry-declared standalone project apps same-origin with traversal protection, 301 trailing-slash redirect, nosniff and frame-ancestors self CSP.

features.name: GET /api/v1/knowledge/search
features.summary: Lexical BM25 search over README/docs/registry with secret redaction and no generated answer; no frontend caller was found and registry/features.json (a corpus input) does not exist.

features.name: GET /api/v1/knowledge/sources
features.summary: Lists indexed documents, skipped files and chunk totals for the knowledge corpus; unused by the frontend.

features.name: Knowledge corpus loader, chunker and BM25 index
features.summary: Fixed-allowlist markdown/registry loader with chunking, redaction of key/token-shaped strings, 5-minute cache and BM25 ranking.

features.name: Built SPA serving with history fallback
features.summary: Serves frontend/dist with MIME map, directory-traversal guard and index.html SPA fallback; 404 message if not built.

features.name: GET/POST /api/missions
features.summary: Lists missions with store integrity, or creates a mission from a JSON definition with Idempotency-Key; restricted to loopback clients and local origins.

features.name: GET /api/missions/:id
features.summary: Returns a mission and its durable event timeline.

features.name: POST /api/missions/:id/{validate,queue,pause,resume,cancel}
features.summary: Drives mission state transitions (dependency validation, queueing, pause/resume/cancel) via the engine state machine.

features.name: POST /api/missions/:id/run (memory-gated queue for worker)
features.summary: Attaches a fresh memory retrieval trace (integrity + recall + conflict check) then returns 202 queued_for_worker, or 409/503 with an action hint if the memory gate fails.

features.name: POST /api/missions/:id/{approve,retry}/:taskId
features.summary: Records a human approve/reject decision with operator ID or retries a failed/blocked task.

features.name: GET /api/missions/:id/{evidence/:taskId,export}
features.summary: Returns a task's execution evidence record or a checksummed exportable mission definition.

features.name: Durable local mission engine
features.summary: Checksummed atomic JSON store with file lock, idempotency keys, DAG validation, state machines, leases, retries, timeouts, approvals and event log under LOCALAPPDATA/ClimateChain/Missions.

features.name: Mission definition import
features.summary: importMission validates a checksummed export and recreates a mission, but no gateway route or UI calls it.

features.name: Task climate.observation_summary
features.summary: Groups declared observations by metric/unit into mean/min/max/period/source summaries with provenance and an uncertainty note.

features.name: Task climate.emissions_scenario
features.summary: Illustrative linear emissions-reduction pathway labelled SIMULATION.

features.name: Task climate.connector_snapshot
features.summary: Worker-only read of AshAlert aggregate stats or a capped AirPulse city PM2.5 sample through the connector registry with privacy-limited output.

features.name: Task report.render
features.summary: Renders a markdown report artifact from referenced task outputs with $ref JSON-pointer resolution.

features.name: Mission memory readiness gate
features.summary: Verifies vault integrity, recalls up to 20 relevant memories for the climate-chain project, blocks on relevant conflicts and attaches manifest SHA-256 to the mission.

features.name: Background mission worker
features.summary: Polling worker that recovers expired leases, re-gates stale memory traces (>5 min), claims queued tasks, runs them and writes a 3 s heartbeat to the worker-status file.

features.name: Mission supervisor and launcher
features.summary: Restarts the worker with exponential backoff (500 ms to 30 s), publishes status, and as CLI spawns the gateway plus supervised worker with signal-based shutdown.

features.name: Worker status record
features.summary: Atomic validated status file shared by worker, supervisor and /api/health, with stale detection after 15 s.

features.name: start.ps1 launcher
features.summary: PowerShell script that checks frontend dependencies, builds the frontend, then runs mission-supervisor.mjs (gateway plus worker) in the gateway directory.

features.name: Gateway npm scripts (start, worker, supervisor, test)
features.summary: package.json exposes node gateway.mjs, mission-worker.mjs, mission-supervisor.mjs and node --test.

features.name: GET /api/agent-memory
features.summary: Full integrity-checked vault snapshot with active/effective entries, manifest and vault SHA-256 and encryption status.

features.name: GET /api/agent-memory/exports
features.summary: Generates portable agent rules markdown, CLAUDE.md text and MCP server config for a project namespace.

features.name: GET /api/agent-memory/backup
features.summary: Exports an integrity-hashed backup envelope of the vault.

features.name: GET /api/agent-memory/backups
features.summary: Lists automatic backup files with integrity validity and at-rest encryption flag.

features.name: GET /api/agent-memory/integrity
features.summary: Validates schema, record digests, version history and relation graph.

features.name: GET /api/agent-memory/conflicts
features.summary: Lists explicitly linked conflicting active decisions in a project namespace.

features.name: GET /api/agent-memory/retrievals
features.summary: Returns the retrieval audit trail (hashed queries, returned IDs, reasons, latency).

features.name: GET /api/agent-memory/search
features.summary: Weighted lexical search with graph-neighbour expansion, scoped to global plus a project namespace and logged to the audit trail.

features.name: POST /api/agent-memory/import
features.summary: Replaces the vault from a reviewed backup after REPLACE_LOCAL_MEMORY confirmation, taking a pre-write backup first.

features.name: POST /api/agent-memory/rotate-key
features.summary: Rotates the DPAPI-protected data key and re-encrypts the vault after ROTATE_MEMORY_KEY confirmation.

features.name: POST /api/agent-memory
features.summary: Creates a v2 memory record (title, rule, why, constraints, relations, priority, verification) with relation validation and prewrite backup.

features.name: PUT /api/agent-memory/:id
features.summary: Updates or archives a record, incrementing revision and keeping up to 20 digest-checked versions.

features.name: DELETE /api/agent-memory/:id
features.summary: Permanently removes a record and strips dangling relation links from others.

features.name: Memory vault storage engine
features.summary: Local sandbox vault (outside project tree) with v1-to-v2 migration, cross-process file lock, atomic writes, size caps, symlink refusal, automatic backups and loopback/origin-only access.

features.name: Memory vault encryption at rest
features.summary: AES-256-GCM envelope encryption with Windows DPAPI-protected or external 32-byte keys, keyring with rotation, applied to vault, backups and audit log.

features.name: Memory retrieval audit log
features.summary: Append-only (capped at 1000 events) log of every recall with hashed query, returned IDs, match reasons and manifest digest.

features.name: Memory decision graph relations
features.summary: dependencies, conflictsWith and supersedes relations validated for existence and project boundaries, with supersession excluding records from effective recall.

features.name: memory-mcp.mjs stdio MCP server
features.summary: Read-only JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP bridge over stdio (protocol 2025-06-18) exposing the local engineering memory with initialize, ping, tools and resources handlers.

features.name: MCP memory tools (10)
features.summary: climate_chain_memory_recall, climate_chain_memory_rules, memory.recall, memory.search, memory.get_decisions, memory.get_constraints, memory.get_related_context, memory.verify_integrity, memory.get_conflicts, memory.get_retrieval_trace, all marked readOnly.

features.name: MCP memory resources
features.summary: climate-chain://memory/rules (markdown) and climate-chain://memory/active (JSON of global memories).

features.name: Connector registry with resilience
features.summary: Read-only GET adapter layer with per-connector schema validation, bounded bodies, retries, circuit breaker, TTL cache and provenance on every read.

features.name: Four source connector contracts
features.summary: DumpWatch, AshAlert, TapAlert and AirPulse descriptors (env-overridable URLs, health paths, schema validators) plus Delhi/Jodhpur/Chandigarh AirPulse city presets.

features.name: Source normalisers and cross-project feed
features.summary: Maps native waste/fire/water/air payloads to a unified model, PM2.5 severity bands and rule-based high/medium/low feed items that each name their modules.

features.name: Labelled mock fallback data
features.summary: Deterministic mock waste/fire/water/air payloads served with mode mock when a connector fails so the UI shows SIMULATED.

features.name: Cascade assessment and evidence manifest
features.summary: Spatial/temporal eligibility checks producing a proximity lead (never causality) and a canonical-JSON SHA-256 manifest.

features.name: Project registry validation and app resolver
features.summary: Validates registry ids, stages and folders at startup, resolves local app roots and refuses path traversal.

features.name: registry/projects.json
features.summary: Single source of truth for 19 project entries (1 central, 18 foldered) and 7 focus groups feeding the gateway, capability library, mission studio and command palette.
